<div class="page">
  <div class="bg-stars" aria-hidden="true"></div>

  <!-- 1. HERO: messages drift upward, as chat does -->
  <header class="a-hero" aria-labelledby="about-title">
    <div class="wrap a-hero-grid">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow">About Epsilon Commons</span>
        <h1 id="about-title" class="split">Mathematics is a conversation. We keep the minutes.</h1>
        <p class="lede reveal">A student-led community that reads, argues, explains, gets stuck, gets unstuck, and then <em>writes down what it learned</em>, in public, for anyone to check, use and improve.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="drift" aria-hidden="true">
        <span class="b" style="--x:0%;--delay:0s">Is every Cauchy sequence convergent?</span>
        <span class="b me" style="--x:42%;--delay:-2.7s">why is d&sup2; = 0?</span>
        <span class="b" style="--x:4%;--delay:-5.4s">wait, it's irrational..</span>
        <span class="b me" style="--x:36%;--delay:-8s">so <i>N</i> depends on &epsilon;!</span>
        <span class="b" style="--x:0%;--delay:-10.7s">a tree on <i>n</i> vertices has <i>n</i> &minus; 1 edges</span>
        <span class="b me" style="--x:40%;--delay:-13.4s">can we do this in Lean?</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="scroll-cue" aria-hidden="true"><span>Scroll</span><i></i></div>
  </header>

  <!-- 2. STORY: scroll-driven. Chat scrolls away; the good parts are filed into a wiki page -->
  <section class="scrolly" aria-labelledby="story-title">
    <div class="scrolly-stage">
      <div class="wrap story-grid">
        <div class="story-copy">
          <h2 id="story-title" class="visually-hidden">How it began</h2>
          <div class="story-step on" data-step="0">
            <span class="step-no">1</span>
            <h3>Chat is where ideas are born.</h3>
            <p>It began in two WhatsApp groups, <strong>The Modern Bourbaki Group</strong> and <strong>The Epsilon Room</strong>: more than thirty students from several institutes, trading questions and arguments.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="story-step" data-step="1">
            <span class="step-no">2</span>
            <h3>And then it scrolls away.</h3>
            <p>The clearest explanation of a lemma sinks under a few hundred messages, and the next person starts from nothing.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="story-step" data-step="2">
            <span class="step-no">3</span>
            <h3>A commons keeps what matters.</h3>
            <p>The parts worth keeping are lifted out, written up, reviewed, and filed where anyone can find them.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="story-fig" role="img" aria-label="Illustration: a chat in which most messages scroll away while three useful ones are moved onto a reviewed wiki page.">
          <div class="chat">
            <div class="chat-head"><i></i><i></i><i></i><span>group chat</span></div>
            <div class="bubble keep">Is every Cauchy sequence convergent?</div>
            <div class="bubble me">anyone free at 6?</div>
            <div class="bubble keep me">In the reals, yes. Here is why&hellip;</div>
            <div class="bubble">ha, same here</div>
            <div class="bubble keep">a tree on <i>n</i> vertices has <i>n</i> &minus; 1 edges</div>
            <div class="bubble me">ok!</div>
          </div>
          <div class="pagecard">
            <div class="page-head"><b>Wiki</b><span>Sequences</span><em class="badge">reviewed &check;</em></div>
            <div class="slot"></div><div class="slot"></div><div class="slot"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- 3. PURPOSE: four aims with self-drawing icons -->
  <section class="purpose" aria-labelledby="purpose-title">
    <div class="wrap">
      <h2 id="purpose-title" class="split">What we are for.</h2>
      <div class="aims">
        <div class="panel reveal observe" style="--i:1">
          <svg class="aim-ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path pathLength="1" d="M4 12a5 5 0 1 0 10 0a5 5 0 1 0 -10 0"/><path pathLength="1" d="M10 12a5 5 0 1 0 10 0a5 5 0 1 0 -10 0"/></svg>
          <h3>Learn together</h3><p>Questions are welcome. &ldquo;I don&rsquo;t follow this step&rdquo; is a perfectly good sentence.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="panel reveal observe" style="--i:2">
          <svg class="aim-ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path pathLength="1" d="M6 3h9l4 4v14H6z"/><path pathLength="1" d="M9 11h7M9 15h7M9 19h4"/></svg>
          <h3>Write it down</h3><p>Notes and worked examples, written once, carefully, and kept up to date.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="panel reveal observe" style="--i:3">
          <svg class="aim-ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path pathLength="1" d="M12 6c-2.5-1.8-6-2-9-1v13c3-1 6.5-.8 9 1c2.5-1.8 6-2 9-1V5c-3-1-6.5-.8-9 1z"/><path pathLength="1" d="M12 6v13"/></svg>
          <h3>Keep it open</h3><p>Free to read, with every change and every author on record.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="panel reveal observe" style="--i:4">
          <svg class="aim-ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path pathLength="1" d="M3 20h8v-6H3z"/><path pathLength="1" d="M11 20h8v-6h-8z"/><path pathLength="1" d="M7 14h8V8H7z"/></svg>
          <h3>Build to last</h3><p>Wiki pages, LaTeX papers and, in time, proofs checked by a computer in Lean.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

      <div class="prose">
        <h2 id="name-title" class="split">Why &ldquo;Epsilon Commons&rdquo;?</h2>
        <p class="reveal">In analysis, <em>&epsilon;</em> is a number you may choose as small as you like, and the game is to show that an answer exists however small you go. We like that: start small, and don&rsquo;t be put off by smallness. One question, one fixed proof, one reviewed paragraph, and in time, a library.</p>
        <p class="reveal"><strong>Commons</strong> is the old word for land held by everyone and looked after by the people who use it.</p>
      </div>

  <!-- 5. HOW A CONTRIBUTION TRAVELS: looping diagram -->
  <section class="travel" aria-labelledby="travel-title">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="reveal">
        <h2 id="travel-title" class="split">How a contribution travels.</h2>
        <p class="section-intro">Every change takes the same short road.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="track" role="list">
        <div class="rail" aria-hidden="true"><i class="dot"></i></div>
        <div class="stop s1" role="listitem"><span class="node">1</span><h3>Write</h3><p>Draft a page, a proof or a paper.</p></div>
        <div class="stop s2" role="listitem"><span class="node">2</span><h3>Review</h3><p>Someone reads it kindly and suggests improvements.</p></div>
        <div class="stop s3" role="listitem"><span class="node">3</span><h3>Merge</h3><p>Once approved, it joins the record.</p></div>
        <div class="stop s4" role="listitem"><span class="node">4</span><h3>Publish</h3><p>The site and the PDFs update themselves.</p></div>
      </div>
      <ul class="principles habits-list">
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:1"><h3>Out in the open</h3><p>Public by default.</p></li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:2"><h3>Reviewed, kindly</h3><p>To improve the work, never to shrink the person.</p></li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:3"><h3>Credit, always</h3><p>Every page keeps its authors and its history.</p></li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:4"><h3>Honest about the unfinished</h3><p>Drafts are marked as drafts.</p></li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:5"><h3>Explain, don&rsquo;t assert</h3><p>The idea first, then the proof.</p></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- 6. WHO IT IS FOR: drifting ways to help -->
  <section class="who" aria-labelledby="who-title">
    <div class="wrap who-text">
      <h2 id="who-title" class="split">If you are curious, you belong.</h2>
      <p class="reveal">Led by students, open to anyone who enjoys mathematics, whether you are meeting your first proof or writing your fifth paper. You only need to care whether something is true, and whether it is clear.</p>
      <p class="note-small reveal">Small contributions count.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="marquee" aria-label="Ways to help">
      <div class="mq-row">
        <ul>
          <li>Ask a good question</li><li>Explain something you just understood</li><li>Fix a typo</li><li>Spot a gap in an argument</li><li>Review a draft</li>
        </ul>
        <ul aria-hidden="true">
          <li>Ask a good question</li><li>Explain something you just understood</li><li>Fix a typo</li><li>Spot a gap in an argument</li><li>Review a draft</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="mq-row rev">
        <ul>
          <li>Draw a figure</li><li>Typeset notes in LaTeX</li><li>Suggest a reading</li><li>Translate an explanation</li><li>Formalise a proof in Lean</li>
        </ul>
        <ul aria-hidden="true">
          <li>Draw a figure</li><li>Typeset notes in LaTeX</li><li>Suggest a reading</li><li>Translate an explanation</li><li>Formalise a proof in Lean</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
